questions.text: What kind of AI is it?
questions.help_text: SS-25-001 defines generative AI as “tools or systems used to create models that can generate new and original content, such as images, music, or text, based on patterns and examples from existing data.” SS-23-002 also defines machine learning and deep learning. None of the documents mentions AI agents; they are grouped with “Other AI”, but if an agent creates new content, choose Generative AI. If you are asking about something with no AI in it, such as an ordinary cloud application, choose “It does not use AI”.

options.label: Generative AI that writes, summarizes, or creates images, audio or video (for example ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or Copilot)

Other AI that predicts, classifies, scores or recommends without creating new content (for example machine learning or deep learning), or an AI agent that carries out tasks or takes actions on its own
Not sure
options.confirm_pointer: Treated as generative AI, which shows every provision that could apply. The documents name no contact for this question; ask your agency.

note.text: The two 2025 documents say they cover generative AI: SS-25-001 says “State government employees shall follow this standard when using commercial GenAI solutions” and GS-25-001 says “These guidelines apply to all forms of generative AI”. outcomes.assembly_rule: If 'scope_gate' matches, the outcome is only its 'outcome' text. Otherwise an outcome is the 'always' block, plus every block in 'blocks' and every pointer in 'conditional_pointers' whose 'when' condition matches the facts set on the path, plus the closing line. A 'when' condition is a list of alternatives; an alternative matches when every fact it names has one of the listed values. A fact that was not asked on the path matches nothing. When 'type_rule.when_other' matches, each element uses 'other_ai_statements' instead of 'statements' and each pointer uses 'other_ai_as_written' instead of 'as_written'; an element with no other_ai_statements, or a pointer whose other_ai_as_written is null, is not shown. Every 'type_notes' entry whose 'when' matches is shown before the results.
